description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); CREATE TABLE L (k LONG CONSTRAINT PK_L PRIMARY KEY); Close; DBEngine.SetOption(dbImplicitCommitSync, "Yes"); OpenDatabase shared read/write. L(k LONG primary key): keys 64636 + 3j for j = 0..559 inserted ascending (enough to split the root, which holds them under prefix 2 because they cross 65536); then keys 200000..200009 (into the new rightmost leaf); then DELETE FROM L WHERE k >= 65536 AND k < 200000, leaving the left leaf with keys 64636..65533 in steps of 3 (sharing 3 bytes, stored prefix not recomputed). Then 320 keys between its entries, 64637 + 3j for j = 0..299 ascending, then 64638 + 3j for j = 0..19, one INSERT each. After the delete and after every fill insert the first 28 bytes (header, free word at 2, prefix length at 24) of pages 44 and 48-55 are read with the database open; after Close pages 44-57 whole. Asks whether the full leaf splits at its stored prefix's capacity (516) or is first rewritten under its common prefix (602), and where it splits. In a shared session under dbImplicitCommitSync "Yes" (the table made in the CreateDatabase session); pages 44 and 48-52 are also kept whole after fill inserts 216, 217 and 218 (round 1 split at the 217th).
retentionNote: r-q17-growth round 2: per-statement split pages under dbImplicitCommitSync Yes, and the repeat of lval-memo (stamp variation)
